bio: A princess dreamed her whole life of joining her knights and riding into a fairytale adventure – but her reality was one of courtly etiquette and restraint. Adventure was only a dream… until a visiting Magi unlocked her Arcana, and Lazenne could leap from her tower to forge storytales of her very own.
